title: Fwd Cargo Door Surround Fitting and Inboard Frame — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Removal of the forward cargo door surround fitting kit and the inboard surround frame sub-assembly, including the sill closing panel and the local lining, for corrosion survey or for protection standard change.

sections.purpose: This task removes the door surround fitting kit and the inboard surround frame sub-assembly at the forward cargo door, so that the frame feet and the skin land behind them become accessible for survey, blend-out or replacement.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the aircraft on the ground and the forward cargo door open and locked in the open position. Make sure the door actuation is depressurised and the safety struts are installed before any person goes under the door. The lower shell lining panels of the forward compartment must come out first. Two persons are needed for the frame sub-assembly, which is heavy and awkward at the sill.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the forward cargo door and install the door safety struts. WARNING: DO NOT GO UNDER THE DOOR UNTIL THE SAFETY STRUTS ARE INSTALLED AND THE ACTUATION IS DEPRESSURISED. 2. Get access to the forward cargo compartment through access panels 111BL and 121AR. 3. Remove the lower shell lining panels in zone 111 and zone 121. Put the panels in a protected position. 4. Disconnect and stow clear the harness that crosses the sill. CAUTION: DO NOT PULL ON THE HARNESS TO MOVE IT. RELEASE EACH CLIP FIRST. 5. Remove the sill closing panel. 6. Loosen the fasteners of the surround fitting kit D5321131361369 in the sequence given in the fastener diagram. Do not remove any fastener until all are loosened. 7. Remove the fasteners and lift out the fitting kit. Keep the washers AES963502K7 and EN736536-59 for inspection. 8. Support the inboard frame sub-assembly D5321134517524 with the sling. 9. Remove the frame sub-assembly fasteners and the plain washers AGS46790-6A, and lower the sub-assembly clear. 10. Clean the exposed frame foot and the skin land with the approved agent and let them dry. 11. Do a visual check of the exposed area and record any finding before further work.
sections.close_out: Put the removed items on the protective mat in the order shown on the layout card. Make sure that the open fastener holes are covered. If the area is to be left open for more than 24 hours, apply the temporary protection of the standard practice. Record the removal and any finding in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft, pre and post MOD-130120

safety_precautions: Install the door safety struts before any person goes under the door.
Make sure that the cargo door actuation is depressurised.
Put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
